design.title: Make verify a true master switch
design.summary: When verify=false, Phase 3 (reviewer), Phase 3b (provider verify + auto-fix loop) must all be skipped. Currently only Phase 3 is gated.

change.description: Wrap the Phase 3b auto-fix loop (lines 699-739) with `if (verifyEnabled) { ... }`. The existing bare block `{ let fixAttempt = 0; ... }` becomes `if (verifyEnabled) { let fixAttempt = 0; ... }`.

what_verify_false_disables: Phase 3: Reviewer agent verification (already gated at line 654)
Phase 3b: runFullVerification() provider checks (tsc, npm test, eslint) — NEW
Phase 3b: Auto-fix coder agent loop — NEW
what_stays_enabled: Task auto-retry (independent concern — retries failed tasks regardless of verify)
awsl verify CLI command (standalone, not part of executeTeam)
design.rationale: Single guard on existing verifyEnabled flag. No new options needed. YAGNI — granular sub-options can be added later if needed.
